sources.note: Actual school overview, degree inventory, complete Graduate Study Areas of Specialization and Doctor of Philosophy sections read through the end before Courses. Mechanical focus areas: materials/design/manufacturing, intelligent systems, bioengineering, energy/propulsion, with explicit physical subfields. Aerospace lists aeroservoelasticity, structures/design optimization, flight controls/aerodynamics/propulsion and physical computational fields. Engineering Analysis describes shared mathematical techniques. Doctorates are Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Cellular and Behavioral Neurobiology in AME. None of these named graduate fields establishes a qualifying Operations/Management Science/Industrial Engineering title; generic optimization, manufacturing, controls and career operations wording are not treated as qualifying titles.

limitations: Incremental scope observation; other remaining engineering schools not yet fully reviewed in this follow-up.
